mapper.sql: SELECT t.id AS templateId, COALESCE(p.exam_subject_id, esf.id) AS examSubjectId, COALESCE(e1.id, e2.id) AS examId, COALESCE(e1.name, e2.name) AS examName, COALESCE(es1.subject_name, esf.subject_name, t.subject_name) AS subjectName, t.name AS templateName, t.update_time AS updateTime FROM answer_sheet_template t LEFT JOIN paper p ON p.id = t.paper_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN exam_subject es1 ON es1.id = p.exam_subject_id AND es1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN exam e1 ON e1.id = es1.exam_id AND e1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN exam_subject esf ON t.paper_id IS NULL AND esf.exam_id = t.exam_id AND esf.subject_name = t.subject_name AND esf.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN exam e2 ON e2.id = t.exam_id AND e2.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 1 AND COALESCE(p.exam_subject_id, esf.id) IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM answer_sheet_region r WHERE r.template_id = t.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.region_type = 2 AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.config, '$.enableAiMarking')) = 'true' )
